title: music_library.json Schema
description: Defines the complete music library: albums, songs, file paths, and Archipelago location mappings. Replaces locations.json and album_metadata.json. Albums that omit 'path' can fall back to albumFolders.json.

artist.description: The artist name, used as a display grouping or fallback album prefix.

bonus_locations.description: Non-song locations to send as checks. Appears in a 'Bonus' section in the tree; clicking sends the check and removes the entry.

albums.description: Ordered list of albums in the library.

name.description: Album name. Used as the tree-view node and as the key for albumOrder.json overrides.

full_album_unlock.description: If true, unlocking the album automatically unlocks all songs in it. Replaces album_metadata.json 'full_album_unlock'.

path.description: Optional folder path for all songs in this album. Replaces albumFolders.json entry.

songs.description: Songs in this album, in play order.

title.description: Song title as displayed in the UI.

location.description: Archipelago location name for server communication. Defaults to 'title' if omitted.

path.description: Optional file path for this specific song. Overrides the album-level 'path'.

type.description: Song classification. Replaces the category-based heuristic in AlbumConverter.

requires.description: Pipe-delimited item names required before this song can be played (e.g. '|Disc 1|' or '|Disc 1|Disc 2|'). Empty string means no requirement.
